load_checkpoint: load a TAPIR checkpoint file and return model params and state
online_model_init: initialize online TAPIR model with frames and query points to extract features
online_model_predict: predict point tracks and occlusions from frames, features, and causal context
get_frame: read and crop a frame from a video capture device to square aspect ratio
run_live_point_tracking: run a live camera-based point tracking demo with mouse click queries and causal inference
